integrity: Finite lower bound proven via an exact, self-contained exhaustive coefficient certificate; witness and crossover proven algebraically. Literature comparison remains same-model and non-independent.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous positive anchoring, unweighted connected undirected simple graphs, binary innate opinions, one added edge; no empirical validation or general result for other domains. A relevant prior article was not fully inspectable.
title: A five-vertex threshold for polarization-increasing links in anchored opinion networks
